nodes.description: Garland–Heckbert QEM edge-collapse (CGAL Constrained_placement). Keep Ratio is the fraction of unconstrained edges to keep. Keep Boundary locks open rims; Preserve vertices lock every incident edge.

nodes.description: Collapse edges shorter than Max Length, shortest first, placing the new vertex at the midpoint (CGAL Surface_mesh_simplification Edge_length_cost). Different from Simplify (Lindstrom–Turk volume) and QEM Simplify (quadric error).

nodes.label: VSA Approximate
nodes.description: Approximate a triangle mesh with planar proxies (CGAL Variational Shape Approximation). Outputs a simplified mesh and proxy count. Useful for CAD-like planarization.

nodes.description: Mean-curvature flow smoothing (PMP smooth_shape). Mesh is temporarily unit-normalized so Time is scale-stable; enable Preserve Scale to restore size.

nodes.label: Fair
nodes.description: Discrete k-harmonic fairing (Botsch/Kobbelt). Continuity k pins the original k-ring, then solves L^{k+1}x=0.

nodes.label: Fair Hole Fill
nodes.description: Fill every boundary loop then fair the patch (CGAL triangulate_refine_and_fair_hole). Original n-gons are kept; only the new hole patches are triangles. Attributes copy from the source mesh; new hole verts solve a cotangent Laplace system (harmonic). Continuity 0/1/2.

nodes.label: Repair
nodes.description: Basic mesh repair: remove degenerates, isolated vertices, and stitch nearby border edges where possible.

nodes.label: Orient Outward
nodes.description: Reorient face winding so normals point consistently outward (closed solid) or consistently for open shells.

nodes.label: Repair Self Intersections
nodes.description: Attempt to remove self-intersections (CGAL PMP). Not always perfect on severe tangles.

nodes.label: Split Long Edges
nodes.description: Subdivide any edge longer than Max Length by inserting midpoints until all edges are shorter.

nodes.label: Autorefine
nodes.description: Refine a mesh at self-intersections so intersection curves become explicit edges (PMP autorefine). Helps before booleans/cleanup.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Snap Borders
nodes.description: Snap and stitch open borders of different islands only (CGAL PMP snap_borders, two-mesh). How to use: Join / Realize several separate pieces whose lips almost meet → set Tolerance to that gap. A vertex never snaps onto another vertex of the same island (so a hole or a single outline is not collapsed). One connected piece is rejected — there is no other island to sew to.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Remove Degenerate
nodes.description: Delete zero-area faces and zero-length edges that break CGAL algorithms.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Repair Degeneracies
nodes.description: Clean zero-area, needle (very skinny) and cap (one almost-flat corner) triangles. How to use: plug a Mesh → leave Cap Angle at 160° and Needle at 4 (CGAL defaults) → leave Collapse Length at 0 unless you also want to weld shorter edges. Safer: Cap Angle 170–179°, Needle 8+. More aggressive: Cap Angle 120–150°, Needle 2–3. Finer than Remove Degenerate, which only deletes exact zero-area faces.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Refine at Isolevel
nodes.description: Split edges where a vertex scalar field crosses Isovalue and insert contour edges (CGAL refine_mesh_at_isolevel). Use Isoline edges for selection / store.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Surface Delaunay Remesh
nodes.description: Remesh a triangle surface with CGAL surface_Delaunay_remeshing (Mesh_3 criteria). Heavy; input should be free of self-intersections.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Convex Decomposition 3D
nodes.description: Approximate a mesh with a user-specified number of convex hulls (UE Geometry Script style). Fast PCA/AABB splits, not exact Nef partition. Mesh is the joined hulls; Instances exposes each hull separately.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Approximate Convex Decomposition
nodes.description: Cover a closed mesh with a bounded number of convex volumes (CGAL 6.2 voxel ACD). Face attribute Part. Resolution is cells on the longest bbox axis; the other axes follow the bbox. Distinct from Convex Decomposition 3, which is exact Nef.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Fill Polyline
nodes.description: Triangulate every closed 3D polyline into a patch (CGAL triangulate_hole_polyline). Mesh wire loops, n-gons, and cyclic curves are all filled. Point and edge attributes on the input ring are kept; interior diagonals are new. Isolated rings only — Fair Hole Fill patches holes in an existing surface.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Straight Skeleton 2D
nodes.description: Complete interior straight skeleton on XY: every island, holes kept, including spokes to the boundary. Face meshes, closed edge rings, or closed solids (XY silhouette union).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Exterior Skeleton 2D
nodes.description: Exterior straight skeleton of an XY polygon (CGAL create_exterior_straight_skeleton_2). Outward wavefront, opposite of Straight Skeleton 2D. Max Offset is the distance from the polygon; the helper frame is discarded. Holes use Straight Skeleton 2D (interior).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Polygon Offset 2D
nodes.description: Offset filled face borders (skeleton), or expand pure edge wires to both sides when the mesh has no faces (cyclic → hollow frame).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Polygon Fill 2D
nodes.description: Fill XY polygon islands with a constrained Delaunay triangulation (holes stay empty). How to use: plug a Mesh of face borders or closed edge rings → get a triangle fill of the interior. Does not insert Steiner points for quality — use Refine Mesh 2D for that.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Polygon Repair 2D
nodes.description: Repair self-intersecting or invalid XY border polygons via even-odd reconstruction (CGAL Polygon_repair).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Regularize Open Contour 2D
nodes.description: Snap open XY polylines to their longest direction and its orthogonal (CGAL regularize_open_contour). Unlike Regularize Contour 2D this keeps curves, does not fill n-gons, and works on open strokes.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Extrude Skeleton
nodes.description: Raise an XY polygon into a hip-roof solid by extruding its straight skeleton (CGAL extrude_skeleton). How to use: plug a 2D island Mesh (holes allowed) → set Height to the ridge height → get a 3D roof. Related: Straight Skeleton 2D is the 2D ridge diagram; this turns it into volume.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Convex Partition 2D
nodes.description: Approximate an XY shape with a user-specified number of convex hulls. Much faster than CGAL polygon partition; each piece is a convex n-gon.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: SSAB Partition 2D
nodes.description: Decompose a simple XY polygon into convex pieces with the small-side angle-bisector strategy (CGAL Small_side_angle_bisector_decomposition_2). How to use: plug a Mesh face → get several convex n-gons (Face attribute island_id). Unlike Convex Partition 2D this cuts along angle bisectors from reflex vertices (the same strategy Minkowski Sum 2D uses internally).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Y-Monotone Partition 2D
nodes.description: Split an XY polygon into y-monotone pieces (CGAL y_monotone_partition_2). Convex Partition 2D and SSAB Partition 2D produce convex pieces instead.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Shape Simplify 2D
nodes.description: Simplify an XY polygon/shape with squared-distance cost (CGAL Polyline_simplification_2). Distinct from Simplify Polyline 3D on Curves.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Refine Mesh 2D
nodes.description: Quality 2D Delaunay refinement of XY polygons (CGAL Mesh_2). Unlike Polygon Fill 2D this inserts Steiner vertices to meet size/shape bounds.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Constrained Delaunay 2D
nodes.description: Constrained Delaunay of the input vertices and edges. Wires use Fill Curve winding. 2D faces use overlapping-face winding. A 3D mesh (front and back in XY) is filled by the union of the projected faces.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Find All Cells 2D
nodes.description: From a 2D edge graph, find every closed loop (CGAL Arrangement_2). Crossing edges get a vertex; each bounded cell is an n-gon that shares verts with neighbors. Works with a pure wire / edge mesh. Face attribute cell_id.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Vertical Decomposition 2D
nodes.description: Split an XY drawing into trapezoids by dropping a vertical line from every vertex. How to use: feed a Mesh of 2D edges or faces → get a mesh of non-overlapping trapezoids (Face attribute island_id). Compared with Find All Cells 2D / Arrangement 2D, this further cuts each cell with vertical walls so every face is y-monotone. Typical use: prepare a floor plan or 2D boolean result for offset / scanline fill.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Tet Remesh
nodes.description: Tetrahedral remesh of a closed solid: Steiner points on an interior grid, keeping Delaunay tets whose circumcenter is inside. Target Edge controls spacing.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Constraint Delaunay 3D
nodes.description: Interior Delaunay tetrahedra of a closed triangle mesh using only the input vertices (no Steiner points). Each tet is a separate 4-triangle island at full scale. Face attribute Tet. Point attributes copy from the source. Distinct from Tet Remesh which inserts an interior grid.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Implicit Surface
nodes.description: Extract a triangle isosurface from a scalar SDF field on a Cartesian grid between Min and Max. Method: Dual Contour (Surface Nets) or Marching Cubes (CGAL TCMC). Distinct from Isosurface 3D (marching tetrahedra on input samples).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: ARAP Deform
nodes.description: As-Rigid-As-Possible surface mesh deformation (CGAL Surface_mesh_deformation). Select ROI and Control verts; set Target positions on controls (e.g. Set Position field). Method 0=Original ARAP, 1=Spokes-and-Rims.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Laplace Deform
nodes.description: Cotangent Laplacian mesh editing with ROI and control handles (Eigen sparse solve). One Laplacian position LS, then one rotation-compensation LS. Not the same as Fair / Smooth Shape.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Cage Deform 3D
nodes.description: Cage-deform an interior mesh: inverse-distance weights on the rest cage, applied to (pose − rest) vertex deltas so two identical cages leave the interior unchanged. Rest and Pose must have the same vertex count and index order (duplicate a cube, then move Pose).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Mesh Boolean
nodes.description: Boolean solid operations (union / difference / intersection) via CGAL corefinement. Prefer closed, manifold triangle meshes.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Corefine
nodes.description: Embed the intersection curves of Mesh 2 into Mesh 1 (PMP corefine). Outputs an Edge selection of those seams on Mesh 1.

nodes.label: Mesh Intersection
nodes.description: Compute surface intersection polylines of two meshes (CGAL surface_intersection). Output is Curves, not a solid boolean volume (use Mesh Boolean for that).

items.name: None

nodes.label: Convex Minkowski Sum 3D
nodes.description: Convex Minkowski sum of two meshes: conv(A) ⊕ conv(B) = conv({a+b}). Non-convex inputs are replaced by their convex hulls first (not exact Nef Minkowski).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Do Intersect 3D
nodes.description: Test whether two triangle meshes intersect (CGAL PMP::do_intersect). Different from Does Self Intersect (one mesh) and Mesh Intersection (curves).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Boolean Ops 2D
nodes.description: 2D boolean of flattened XY shapes (faces with XY area). Fill rule is non-zero winding: overlapping same-orientation faces stay inside, so Difference punches those overlaps; opposite-orientation overlaps cancel. How to use Difference: Mesh A = the stock (e.g. a bounding rectangle), Mesh B = the cutters (scattered grids / islands). The output is the leftover region with B actually punched out — holes stay empty. Leave Mesh B empty to get the silhouette of A. Join or Realize Instances on B first if the cutters are instances.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Do Intersect 2D
nodes.description: True if two XY polygons overlap — either their edges cross, or one contains the other. How to use: plug two 2D Meshes → read Intersect. This is a yes/no test, not a boolean volume (use Boolean Ops 2D for that).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Minkowski Sum 2D
nodes.description: 2D Minkowski sum A ⊕ B of two XY polygons (CGAL reduced convolution): the region swept by placing a copy of B at every point of A. How to use: Mesh A = the part, Mesh B = a disk / square → get the offset / grown outline (holes possible). Different from Polygon Offset 2D (skeleton offset of one shape) and Convex Minkowski Sum 3D (3D convex hulls).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Does Self Intersect
nodes.description: Test whether any faces of the mesh intersect each other (excluding shared edges/verts).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Mark Self Intersect
nodes.description: Copy mesh and mark faces that participate in self-intersections with Face bool attribute "Self Intersect".

nodes.label: Is Closed
nodes.description: True if the mesh has no boundary edges (topologically closed). Does not prove it is a solid without self-intersections.

items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Mesh Volume
nodes.description: Compute signed volume of a closed mesh. Open meshes may return 0 or unreliable values.

nodes.label: Centroid

nodes.label: Side Of Mesh
nodes.description: For each query point, test inside/outside a closed triangle mesh. Writes boolean attribute "Inside" (true = bounded side).

items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Skeleton
nodes.description: Mean-curvature-flow curve skeleton of a closed mesh (medial-axis-like stick figure as a curve).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Segment Mesh
nodes.description: Segment a closed mesh into parts using Shape Diameter Function (SDF) + clustering. Writes Face attributes "Segment" and "SDF".

nodes.label: Curvature

nodes.label: Principal Curvature
nodes.description: Field node: principal curvatures k_min/k_max and their tangent directions on the context mesh.

nodes.label: Shape Diameter
nodes.description: Field node: Shape Diameter Function (local thickness) per face of a closed mesh. Larger values mean thicker regions.

nodes.label: Region Growing
nodes.description: Grow planar face regions. Writes Face int "Region" (0,1,2...; -1 unassigned). Topology unchanged — label only. Color by Named Attribute on Face domain.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Surface Shortest Path
nodes.description: Geodesic (surface) shortest path between Source and Target, snapped to the mesh. Output is a wire/path mesh along the surface.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Exact Geodesic Distance
nodes.description: Exact multi-source geodesic distance on the mesh surface (CGAL Surface_mesh_shortest_path). Field node: mark Source verts → Distance per point. Unreachable = -1. Different from Heat Geodesic (approximate).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Geodesic Voronoi
nodes.description: Partition a triangle mesh by nearest source along geodesic distance (CGAL Surface_mesh_shortest_path MMP). Faces are cut on the geodesic-equidistant bisector, not along the input triangulation. Face attribute cell_id is the source vertex index.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Skeleton Spokes
nodes.description: Mean-curvature-flow skeleton plus a spoke from each node to the surface vertices that contracted into it (CGAL extract_mean_curvature_flow_skeleton correspondence). Skeleton is only the centerline.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Self Intersection Curves
nodes.description: Emit the self-intersection polylines of one triangle mesh (CGAL PMP::self_intersections + triangle-triangle intersection). Unlike Mark Self Intersect this outputs Curves, and unlike Mesh Intersection it uses a single mesh.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Mesh Slicer
nodes.description: Slice a triangle mesh with an infinite plane and output the cut as Curves (CGAL Polygon_mesh_slicer). How to use: plug a Mesh → set Origin on the plane and Normal as the facing → get polylines. This is a contour, not a solid boolean (use Mesh Boolean / Clip to cut volume).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Contour Stack
nodes.description: Slice a triangle mesh with a stack of parallel planes (CGAL Polygon_mesh_slicer). Mesh Slicer is a single plane. Spacing 0 fits Count slices across the mesh along Direction.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Geodesic Isolines
nodes.description: Draw isolines of multi-source geodesic distance on a triangle mesh (CGAL Surface_mesh_shortest_path MMP). Exact Geodesic is a vertex field; Refine at Isolevel splits the mesh; Geodesic Voronoi partitions cells.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Inscribed Sphere 3D
nodes.description: Largest sphere inside the convex hull of the input points (Chebyshev center). Takes a point cloud or mesh vertices. The 3D analog of Largest Inscribed Circle 2D. Coplanar or nearly flat point sets have no interior and fail.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Graphcut Segment
nodes.description: Split a mesh into feature patches: region-grow faces while the dihedral angle is below Angle, so planar areas stay together and cuts fall on sharp edges. Not a world-axis split. Writes face attribute Segment. Color by Named Attribute. Distinct from Region Growing (which fits primitives on points).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Sphere Intersect
nodes.description: Intersection circles of spheres centered at points (Circular kernel constructions).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Sphere Arrangement
nodes.description: Great circles of face planes on the unit sphere around Origin.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Visibility 2D
nodes.description: Visibility polygon from a query among XY walls (one connected n-gon). Filled faces: only the border is solid, so holes stay free space. Loose edges are thin walls. Query must be inside the walls bounding box.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Largest Inscribed Circle 2D
nodes.description: Largest circle that fits inside the XY polygon and is tangent to the boundary (segment Voronoi / medial-axis vertex). Holes are obstacles. Use a 2D filled or border polygon; closed 3D meshes use the XY silhouette.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Medial Axis 2D
nodes.description: 2D medial axis (MAT) of an XY polygon: discrete Voronoi of the boundary (parabolic branches approximated as polylines). Different from Straight Skeleton 2D (angle bisectors). Not a 3D MAT — for solids use Skeleton (MCF).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: LSCM UV
nodes.description: Least Squares Conformal Map UV (CGAL LSCM). Field on context mesh → Corner UV. Each connected component is unwrapped as its own island (then packed if Normalize). Closed shells need Seam edges. Store with Store Named Attribute (Corner Vector/Float2).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: ARAP UV
nodes.description: As-Rigid-As-Possible UV parameterization (CGAL ARAP_parameterizer_3). Field node: Seam + Selection + Normalize. Output Corner UV for UVMap.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: UV Distortion
nodes.description: Measure parameterization distortion per face from Corner UV vs 3D geometry. Area Stretch ≈ 1 means area-preserving; Conformal Stretch ≈ 1 means angle-preserving. Related to CGAL measure_distortion (L2 stretch family).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Alpha Shape
nodes.description: Build a 3D alpha-shape surface from points (Delaunay filtration). Smaller Alpha keeps denser parts; Optimal Alpha auto-picks a solid component threshold.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Alpha Wrap
nodes.description: Offset/wrap geometry with a watertight alpha-wrap envelope (CGAL alpha_wrap_3). Useful to close holes and get a robust outer shell.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Advancing Front
nodes.description: From a point cloud, grow a triangle surface by advancing a front (CGAL advancing_front_surface_reconstruction). Good for open surfaces; Radius Ratio / Beta control triangle shape and front advance.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Poisson Reconstruct
nodes.description: Poisson surface reconstruction from oriented points. Uses attribute "normal" when present, else estimates.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Scale Space Reconstruct
nodes.description: Scale-space reconstruction for noisy unorganized points: Weighted-PCA multi-scale smoothing, then Alpha-shape connectivity mapped back onto the original samples (interpolating surface). Different pipeline from standalone Alpha Shape / Advancing Front.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Skin Surface
nodes.description: Reconstruct a smooth surface as the skin (shrunk union) of balls centered on the input points (CGAL Skin_surface_3). Radius field controls ball size.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Union of Balls
nodes.description: Mesh the outer surface of the union of balls (CGAL make_union_of_balls_mesh_3). No shrink (unlike Skin Surface). Use sparse points; dense sets are subsampled.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Crust 2D
nodes.description: Amenta–Bern–Eppstein crust: Delaunay of the XY samples union their Voronoi vertices, then keep edges that join two original samples. Reconstructs a curve from a dense point sampling. Distinct from OTR Reconstruct 2D.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Alpha Complex 3D
nodes.description: 3D alpha complex as tetrahedron shells (CGAL Alpha_shape_3 cells). Unlike Alpha Shape (surface only) this exports the volume tets. Face attribute alpha_tet.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Alpha Wrap 2D
nodes.description: Watertight 2D wrap of XY points or segments (CGAL 6.2 Alpha_wrap_2).

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: Jet Estimate Normals
nodes.description: CGAL jet_estimate_normals (local polynomial/surface fit) + MST orient. Writes float3 attribute "normal". Faster alternative: PCA; sharper creases: VCM.

items.name: None
items.description: Default color tag for new nodes and node groups

nodes.label: VCM Estimate Normals
nodes.description: Estimate normals with Voronoi Covariance Measure (feature-aware), then MST orient. Often better than Jet near sharp edges. Radii are absolute scene units.

items.name: None
